groups.rationale: Reviewed: trace-schema.json regenerated by generate_schema.exs from current production literals, adding the terminal.viewer_refused gateway/attach reasons and trunk Android display vocabulary already present in source; the trace vocabulary contract and its derivation are unchanged.

Reviewed: porsche-threads now composes after the Porsche scenario's key approval and authorized dispatch (porsche-threads-fleet-scope contract revised) and no longer waits for a model-executed turn, because the fleet has no model provider and same-mode prompts queue; guest lifecycle, sharing and relocation stay in porsche-fleet. Its thread and web evidence is promoted to recorded from the passing run cited in the M6 review, gaps restated, chapter 19 regenerated, and ADR-0222 evidence updated.
